sentences.en: Welcome back to my Slow English podcast. Today.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。今天。

sentences.en: We will be reading Swimming by Leo Leone. Read slow English children's books with me. A happy school of little red fish lived in a corner of the sea somewhere.
sentences.tc: 我們將閱讀 Leo Leone 的《游泳》。和我一起讀慢速英語兒童讀物。在某個海域的某個角落裡，住著一群快樂的小紅魚。

sentences.en: They were all red. Only one of them was black. as a muscle shell.
sentences.tc: 他們都是紅色的。其中只有一個是黑色的。作為肌肉外殼。

sentences.en: He swam faster than his brothers and sisters. His name was Swimmie. One day, a bad tuna fish, swift, fierce, and very hungry, came darting through the waves. In one gulp,.

sentences.en: He swam away in the deep wet world.
sentences.tc: 他在深濕的世界裡遊走了。

sentences.en: He was scared, lonely, and very sad. But the sea was full of wonderful creatures. And as.
sentences.tc: 他很害怕，很孤獨，也很悲傷。但大海裡充滿了奇妙的生物。和作為。

sentences.en: He swam from marvel to marvel, Simmyi was happy again.

sentences.en: He saw a medusa made of rainbow jelly. A lobster who walked about like a watermoving machine. Strange fish pulled by an invisible thread. A forest of seaweeds growing from sugar candy.
sentences.tc: 他看到了一個由彩虹果凍製成的美杜莎。一隻像運水機器一樣走來走去的龍蝦。奇怪的魚被一條看不見的線拉著。從糖中長出的海藻森林。

sentences.en: Rocks. An eel whose tail was almost too far away to remember. Too far away. and sea anemies who looked like pink palm trees swaying in the wind.
sentences.tc: 岩石。一條鰻魚，尾巴離得太遠，幾乎記不清了。太遠了。還有看起來像粉紅色棕櫚樹在風中搖曳的海洋敵人。

sentences.en: Then hidden in his dark shade of rocks and weeds,.
sentences.tc: 然後隱藏在岩石和雜草的黑暗陰影中。

sentences.en: He saw a school of little fish, just like his own. Let's go and swim and play and see things.
sentences.tc: 他看到一群小魚，就像他自己的一樣。我們去游泳、玩耍、看看東西吧。

sentences.en: We must think of something. Swimmie thought and thought.
sentences.tc: 我們必須想點辦法。斯威米想了又想。

sentences.en: He said, "I have it.
